title: fix(pm): one reading of the 席位核对 record for fleet-roster and H69
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9WXrD8j89X92edJ7iXHVEhk)_
Fixes #26335
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:车队总表(fleet-roster)判断 PR 是否带落地结论时,和 H69 巡查判断有没有席位记录时,现在读同一条 `## 席位核对` 规则;标题行内写 `— ACCEPT` 的记录也算 ACCEPT。
- 为什么改:席位实际发的记录是 `## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · …`,H69 认得,总表却认不得,导致总表把已 ACCEPT 的 PR 报成"无结论"。
- 风险与回滚:只动 PM 工具脚本、不发布任何包;总表与 H69 都是只报告不拦截。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/seat-record.mjs`(新的共享规则),`scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs` 的 `hasLandingVerdict`,`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` 的 `SEAT_RECORD_MARKER` 导入处。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`,预期两行 ✓(78 例 / 5034 例全过)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- New `scripts/pm/seat-record.mjs`, no imports and no I/O: `SEAT_RECORD_MARKER` (moved verbatim from `check-half-states.mjs`), `SEAT_RECORD_VERDICTS` (`ACCEPT`, `REWORK`, `REJECT`), `seatRecordOf(body)` and `seatRecordAccepts(body)`. The verdict is read inline on the heading line first (`## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · …`), else from the first line below the heading that opens with a verdict word (`**ACCEPT** · …`). Only `ACCEPT` lands a pull.
- `fleet-roster.mjs` `hasLandingVerdict`: the 席位核对 arm is now `seatRecordAccepts(body)`. The `## Contract review` PASS arm is unchanged.
- `check-half-states.mjs`: `SEAT_RECORD_MARKER` is imported from the shared module and re-exported under its old name. H69's reading is byte-identical: the same regex object source, still read through `latestMarkedComment`.
- The module is a sibling of its two readers, not under `scripts/pm/lib/`. A multi-segment import specifier counts as a dispatch-gates watch hint, and gate files that import one lose the hint (measured on an earlier card). The card's hypothesis allowed either place.

Behaviour changes in the roster read, all intended:
1. The inline `— ACCEPT` heading counts (the defect).
2. A blockquoted record (`> ## 席位核对`) counts, as H69 already read it.
3. The verdict must sit on the heading or below it. A line-initial `ACCEPT` above the heading no longer counts, and an inline `REWORK` is never overridden by a later `ACCEPT` line.

## Tests

- `fleet-roster.mjs --self-test`: 5 new cases (inline ACCEPT, inline REWORK, blockquoted record, ACCEPT above the heading, and the three measured bodies read through the imported marker). 73 → 78 cases, 8 batteries.
- `check-half-states.mjs --self-test`: 4 new cases in the H69 battery (the marker reads the inline heading; H69 is clean on an inline record newer than the head; the three measured bodies read record/ACCEPT as `true/true`, `true/true`, `false/false`; inline REWORK and REJECT below are records that never accept). H69 66 → 70 cases (floor 40), 5030 → 5034 total.
- No forced test edits: every existing case passes unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- The card asks that "the two recognisers answer the same on the three measured bodies". They ask different questions: H69 asks whether a record is there, and the roster asks whether the pull may land. So the shared question, the seat record and its ACCEPT, is pinned in both self-tests. On the `## Contract review` PASS body both read "no seat record". The roster still answers `true` there through its separate Contract review arm, which is correct.
- H69 reads the marker through `markerMatches`, which also undecorates bold or backtick-wrapped lines. The roster tests the raw body. A decorated heading such as `**## 席位核对**` would still read differently. No live record has that shape. It is noted here and not widened, because `markerMatches` lives inside `check-half-states.mjs`.
- No pm-dispatch skill text changed: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` is held by another card, so this PR is not on a governed surface. Whether the skill needs a sentence stating the heading spelling is listed in the report's open questions.

## Verification

All readings on head `f9a39c24` (the last commit), local.

<details><summary>Self-tests and reverse verification</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test`: `✓ fleet-roster self-test: 78 cases in 8 batteries pass.` (main `7c34e5dc`: 73 cases)
- `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`: `✓ check-half-states self-test: 5034 cases pass.`, H69 battery `70/40` (main: 5030, `66/40`)
- Reverse verification, after the fix was committed: with the old bare-heading regex put back in `hasLandingVerdict` on disk, the roster self-test exits 1 with 4 failures (inline ACCEPT, blockquoted record, ACCEPT above the heading, the three measured bodies). Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`; `git diff HEAD` is empty, and the self-test is green again.

</details>

<details><summary>dispatch-gates: 47 derived, 47 run, all exit 0</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 47 commands for the three paths. Every one exited 0, captured before any pipe. `--ran` with `COMMAND :: exit CODE` lines: `Run reconciliation — 47 derived, 47 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.` and `47 of 47 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3`. Among them: `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`, `pnpm check:pm-half-states`, `pnpm check:self-test-wired`, `pnpm check:watch-hint-literal`, `pnpm check:scripts-symbol-anchors`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`. Families outside the derived total are CI's.

</details>
